d: Deshbhar ke sath-sath jharkhand men bhi sanvidhan divas ke avsar par kaee karyakramon ka aayojan kiya gaya. pradhanmantri narendr modi ne rashtr pratham aur kartavy bhav ko sarvopri rakhne ka sandesh dete hue nagrikon se sanvaidhanik mulyon aur aadarshon ke prati apni jimmedari nibhane ka aahvan kiya. is avsar par vibhinn sarkari karyalyon aur sansthanon men sanvidhan ki prastavna ka samuhik path kiya gaya. vahin, jharkhand vidhanasbha ke vistarit vishesh satr ke dusre din khan aur khanij adhiniyam par charcha huee. charcha ke dauran satta paksh ne rajy ki aarthik sthiti ko majbut banane…
